name: Harvester
description: The Winterworks Harvester: a big, gentle prehistoric herbivore with a huge hammerhead-shark-like head, small friendly eyes at the ends of the hammer, a broad nose, a shovel mouth that hides rows of cropping teeth until it opens, a scaly mustard-yellow body on four thick legs with a dark green plated back, scutes down the spine and a banded tail, mossy fur accents, ferns and wildflowers. Two-tone, a small palette, painted in strokes. Saddle and saddlebag chests are separate bones the game shows or hides. Minecraft pixel units, density 2: exports 1:1 to a vanilla entity model.
